captions.detailed: This 3D model features a clamp-base monitor-mount task lamp rendered in a uniform matte black finish with a silver metal clamp screw. The base is structured as a sturdy C-clamp that secures to a desk edge, supporting a vertical post on a revolute swivel joint. Extending from the post is a multi-link arm, including a dual-rod shoulder link, a rectangular elbow link, a telescoping prismatic forearm, and a small rectangular LED head that tilts on a horizontal hinge at the tip.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a clamp-base monitor-mount task lamp. The assembly must include a C-clamp base with a vertical screw, a rotating swivel post, a two-link arm with a dual-rod shoulder and a rectangular elbow, a telescoping prismatic forearm, and a tilting rectangular light head at the end.
captions.factory: The object is built by defining individual links as parts with specific visual geometries. The base is constructed using box primitives for the C-clamp body and a cylinder for the clamping screw. The swivel post is modeled with cylinders. The shoulder link combines a box bracket with parallel cylindrical rods. The elbow link is a solid box, followed by a smaller nested box representing the telescoping forearm. Finally, the lamp head is created as a flat box. These components are connected programmatically using revolute, prismatic, and fixed joints with appropriate origins and rotation axes.
